views.name: ride
views.title: Down the cliff road
views.caption: the wall rising on the left, the drop on the right, a kicker’s chevrons ahead; the road carved in combs of cuts

views.name: wide
views.title: On a bigger screen
views.caption: the far ranges, the valley and its river below

views.name: run
views.title: A run, scored
views.caption: the score top right, the mode’s distance under it, and the combo pending: a backflip, its airtime, a clean landing, ×1; the trick called across the screen

views.name: card
views.title: The run’s card
views.caption: at the end of the mode (here RUN, three kilometres): the score, distance, time, tricks, best combo and falls; a run of yours that makes the board is yours to sign; the sim’s are never kept

views.name: title
views.title: The title
views.caption: the sim’s rider showing off behind it; c15r’s autograph across the logo; ride, the mode, the leaderboard

views.name: board
views.title: The leaderboard
views.caption: each mode’s best runs in this browser, each signed; the PAR signed by Claude

views.name: side
views.title: From the side
views.caption: cut colour: the orange jersey and bodywork, the legs and the machine one charcoal, cream where it touches and steers

views.name: whip
views.title: A whip
views.caption: steered in the air: the machine laid over and yawed under the rider

views.name: flip
views.title: Coming round from a backflip
views.caption: the eye eased out to the drop side for a long flight

views.name: ruts
views.title: Carved ruts
views.caption: the road told as a linocut tells it: combs of parallel cuts going with the road, each with a violet ink wall and a white lip; short choppy cuts below a rock step

views.name: ruts-bend
views.title: Through a bend
views.caption: the combs longer and leaning out

views.name: whoops
views.title: Whoops
views.caption: hatching across the face of each hump, so the humps read as humps

views.name: bolts
views.title: The ruts as they were
views.caption: bolts (`ruts=bolts`): chains of thin dark wedges along the riding lines

views.name: speed
views.title: Speed
views.caption: white and pale, the air: streaks hung ahead that the eye flies through; orange off the back as the engine pushes; posts smeared back

views.name: air
views.title: The air peeling off the rider
views.caption: leaning into a bend: streaks of air leaving the figure’s flank, fine at the body and broadening toward the eye; on the ground never up off the top (from behind, that reads as hair on end)
